title: China A-Share
description: Real-time and historical market data for Chinese A-shares (Shanghai/Shenzhen/Beijing) backed by the akshare library — quotes, K-lines, indices, boards, capital flow, news, announcements, financials, and trading-day calendar.

cn_stock_get_quote.title: Get Quote
cn_stock_get_quote.description: Real-time spot quote (price, change, volume, P/E, P/B, market cap) for one or more A-shares.

cn_stock_get_kline.title: Get K-Line
cn_stock_get_kline.description: Daily/weekly/monthly OHLCV bars for a single A-share, with forward/back adjustment.

cn_stock_get_index.title: Get Index
cn_stock_get_index.description: Spot value (and optional 30-day history) for major Chinese stock indices.

cn_stock_get_board.title: Get Board
cn_stock_get_board.description: Industry / concept board snapshot ranked by intraday percentage change.

cn_stock_get_capital_flow.title: Get Capital Flow
cn_stock_get_capital_flow.description: Net capital inflow/outflow for an individual stock or the whole market.

cn_stock_get_news.title: Get News
cn_stock_get_news.description: Recent news for a specific A-share or top macro financial headlines.

cn_stock_get_announcement.title: Get Announcement
cn_stock_get_announcement.description: Listed-company announcements (公告) for a given date.

cn_stock_get_financials.title: Get Financials
cn_stock_get_financials.description: Key financial metrics (EPS, ROE, profit, revenue, margins) by reporting period.

cn_stock_is_trading_day.title: Is Trading Day
cn_stock_is_trading_day.description: Check whether a given date is an A-share trading day. Use at the top of every scheduled task to skip holidays.
